news.headline: Wells Fargo Raises uniQure Price Target to $75 from $60
news.source: Wells Fargo & Company (via Defense World/American Banking News)
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing improved visibility into the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway following FDA feedback.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, $65 Price Target
news.summary: Analyst Rudy Li upgraded QURE from Peer Perform to Outperform, arguing the market is underpricing AMT-130's approval odds (Wolfe estimates ~70% probability) and projecting peak U.S. sales of about $2 billion.

news.headline: uniQure Reports Q2 2026 Results: Cash Runway Extended to 2030, Stock Rises Despite Wider Loss
news.summary: Revenue of $5.8M missed estimates and the quarterly loss widened to $1.22/share, but shares jumped roughly 5% as the company reaffirmed cash of $810.3M funding operations into 2030, confirmed the AMT-130 BLA/UK MAA submissions remain on track for Q3 2026, and reiterated four-year topline AMT-130 data due in September 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Closes Upsized $259 Million Public Offering
news.summary: uniQure closed its upsized offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50/share, raising about $259 million gross to fund commercialization readiness for AMT-130, a confirmatory study, and general corporate purposes.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: uniQure reported six-month follow-up data from the first, low-dose AMT-260 cohort (n=6), with three of six patients showing 79-100% reductions in disabling seizures and no drug-related serious adverse events; enrollment of the higher-dose second cohort is underway.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease After FDA Reverses Course
news.summary: Following a Type B meeting, the FDA told uniQure that the ~3-year Phase I/II data can serve as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130, reversing an earlier 2025/early-2026 regulatory setback; shares surged roughly 70-78% on the news as the company confirmed plans to submit the BLA (and a UK MAA) in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to release topline four-year data from the AMT-130 Phase I/II Huntington's disease study.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Company reaffirmed at Q2 2026 earnings it remains on track to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA under the accelerated approval pathway, based on 3-year Phase I/II data, following the FDA's June 2026 alignment on this pathway.

catalysts.label: UK MAA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following a successful MHRA pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application in the UK based on the 3-year analysis.

catalysts.label: Agreement with FDA on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: FDA has asked uniQure to finalize the design of a required post-approval confirmatory trial, expected to be a randomized, standard-of-care-controlled study with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 second dose cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second, higher-dose cohort in the GenTLE Phase I/IIa epilepsy study, reaffirmed at Q2 2026 earnings.

catalysts.label: FDA priority review decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Potential accelerated approval decision timeline following BLA submission and (if granted) priority review; exact PDUFA date not yet set.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 updated Phase I/IIa data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present updated results from the epilepsy gene therapy program including further dose-cohort follow-up.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on prior-year cadence (Q3 2025 reported Nov 10, 2025); analysts estimate around Nov 10, 2026 but exact date not yet officially announced.

pulse: As of early August 2026, uniQure trades in the mid-$40s, still riding the wave from June's FDA reversal that opened an accelerated-approval path for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease; Q2 earnings reaffirmed cash into 2030 (after a $259M raise) and confirmed the BLA/UK MAA filings remain on track for Q3 2026. Analyst sentiment is largely bullish but not unanimous - Wells Fargo ($75) and Wolfe Research (Outperform, $65) both turned more positive in late July, while Barclays trimmed its target to $60 the same week - and preliminary AMT-260 epilepsy data (79-100% seizure reductions in early responders) is adding a second pipeline growth story. The dominant near-term catalyst remains the pivotal four-year AMT-130 topline data expected in September 2026, alongside the Q3 BLA/MAA submissions and finalization of the FDA-mandated confirmatory trial design.
